versions.content: Bit 3 of the NetworkStateLIN shall contain the Header Tx Error state. This is an error that is related to the source frame that is reported in the same data item. The Header Tx Error state shall be set to 1 when the LIN controller detected an error during transmission of a LIN header. Otherwise it shall be set to 0 .
